entries.en: The distinction is cognizable even without specialized training.
entries.zh: 即使没有专业训练，这种区别也可以认识到。

entries.en: The diagram labels the cholinergic neurons in green.
entries.zh: 图中用绿色标出了胆碱能神经元。

entries.en: She disliked the mummery surrounding the appointment ceremony.
entries.zh: 她不喜欢任命仪式中那些装模作样的虚礼。

entries.en: They signed a bill of sale for the old motorboat.
entries.zh: 他们为那艘旧摩托艇签署了卖契。

entries.en: The dispute eventually led to an action at law.
entries.zh: 这场争议最终引发了一起法律诉讼。

entries.en: The customer was hard to please about every tiny detail.
entries.zh: 那位顾客对每个微小细节都很挑剔，很难取悦。

entries.en: The accountant prepared a profit and loss account for the quarter.
entries.zh: 会计编制了这个季度的损益表。

entries.en: The roommates get along despite their very different schedules.
entries.zh: 室友们尽管作息很不相同，仍然相处融洽。

entries.en: The teacher tapped out the time value of each note.
entries.zh: 老师敲出了每个音符的时值。

entries.en: The torero entered the arena wearing a richly embroidered jacket.
entries.zh: 斗牛士穿着绣工华丽的外套走进了竞技场。

entries.en: The veterinary textbook includes a section on aspergillosis in birds.
entries.zh: 这本兽医教材中有一节关于鸟类曲霉病的内容。

entries.en: The contract expressly preserves the customer's right of action.
entries.zh: 合同明确保留了客户提起诉讼的权利。

entries.en: The seedlings depend on regular watering during dry weather.
entries.zh: 天气干燥时，幼苗依赖定期浇水。

entries.en: The exercise compares imports and exports to calculate the balance of trade.
entries.zh: 这道练习通过比较进口额和出口额来计算贸易差额。

entries.meaningZh: 最后但并不是最不重要的
entries.en: Last but not least, we thank the volunteers who cleaned the hall.
entries.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，我们感谢打扫大厅的志愿者。

entries.en: The two sisters come together in a warm embrace.
entries.zh: 两姐妹相见，热情地拥抱在一起。

entries.en: The child tried not to make a face at the sour plum.
entries.zh: 孩子尝到酸梅时，尽量忍着不做怪脸。

entries.en: Could you take a look at the damaged frame?
entries.zh: 你能看一下这个损坏的框架吗？

entries.en: The collector kept a carved meerschaum in a padded case.
entries.zh: 收藏家把一支雕花海泡石烟斗放在有衬垫的盒子里。

entries.en: The sections slide telescopically inside one another for storage.
entries.zh: 各段可以伸缩套入彼此内部，方便收纳。

entries.en: The lecture distinguished candidiasis from several other fungal infections.
entries.zh: 讲座区分了念珠菌病和另外几种真菌感染。

entries.en: The collected samples fall into three clearly defined groups.
entries.zh: 收集的样本分成了三个界限明确的组。

entries.en: Several rooms, for instance the library, need new curtains.
entries.zh: 有几个房间需要新窗帘，例如图书室。

entries.en: At first sight, the two keys appeared identical.
entries.zh: 乍一看，这两把钥匙似乎一模一样。

entries.en: A work party cleared fallen branches from the path.
entries.zh: 一个工作组清除了路上的断枝。

entries.en: The actors rehearsed a scene of fighting hand to hand.
entries.zh: 演员们排练了一场近身搏斗的戏。

entries.en: The report listed fluorosis among the conditions under investigation.
entries.zh: 报告将氟中毒列为调查中的病症之一。

entries.en: The family tree identifies him as an agnate of the heir.
entries.zh: 家谱表明他是继承人的父系亲属。

entries.en: The botany seminar examined polyploidy in cultivated plants.
entries.zh: 植物学研讨会探讨了栽培植物的多倍性。

entries.en: The troupe booked a one-night stand at the village theater.
entries.zh: 剧团在乡村剧院安排了一场单夜演出。

entries.en: She promised to follow through until the repairs were complete.
entries.zh: 她答应坚持到底，直到修理完成。

entries.en: The archive received one hundred photographs from the family.
entries.zh: 档案馆收到了来自这个家庭的一百张照片。

entries.en: Clear labels make for fewer mistakes during packing.
entries.zh: 清晰的标签有助于减少包装过程中的错误。

entries.en: Please bring back the library books before Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五前把图书馆的书带回来。

entries.en: We can reason out the missing step from these clues.
entries.zh: 我们可以根据这些线索推理出缺失的步骤。

entries.en: The instrument operated stably throughout the overnight recording.
entries.zh: 仪器在整夜记录期间稳定运行。

entries.en: The seller challenged the apparent undervaluation of the antique cabinet.
entries.zh: 卖方质疑了对这个古董柜子明显偏低的估价。

entries.en: The lesson compared two systems of numeration.
entries.zh: 这节课比较了两种命数法。

entries.en: You will go past the bakery before reaching the bridge.
entries.zh: 你到桥之前会经过面包店。

entries.en: The substitute proved up to the demanding assignment.
entries.zh: 替补人员证明自己能胜任这项要求很高的任务。

entries.en: We cannot say for certain when the repairs will end.
entries.zh: 我们无法肯定地说维修何时结束。

entries.en: The larger workshop gained an economy of scale in purchasing materials.
entries.zh: 更大的工场在采购材料方面获得了规模经济效益。

entries.en: The sleeping child looked peaceful at rest.
entries.zh: 熟睡的孩子安眠着，显得很平静。

entries.en: The fictional couple decide not to sleep with each other yet.
entries.zh: 这对虚构的伴侣决定暂时不发生性关系。

entries.en: The tasting exercise asks students to describe their sense of taste.
entries.zh: 品尝练习要求学生描述自己的味觉体验。

entries.en: Even experienced announcers occasionally misspeak a difficult surname.
entries.zh: 即使经验丰富的播音员，偶尔也会念错难读的姓氏。

entries.en: The yardman trimmed the hedge beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 场地工人修剪了入口旁的树篱。

entries.en: The labeled drawing shows a single lobule of the organ.
entries.zh: 这幅带标注的图展示了该器官的一个小叶。

entries.en: The partners invited her to buy into their printing business.
entries.zh: 合伙人邀请她出资入股他们的印刷企业。

entries.en: The inspector visited their registered place of business.
entries.zh: 检查员走访了他们登记的营业地点。

entries.en: On occasion, the gardener opens the greenhouse to visitors.
entries.zh: 有时园丁会向游客开放温室。

entries.en: We may put off the roof inspection until the rain stops.
entries.zh: 我们可能把屋顶检查推迟到雨停以后。

entries.en: The physiology lecture introduced the all-or-none law using a nerve diagram.
entries.zh: 生理学讲座用一张神经示意图介绍了全或无定律。

entries.en: He had to look away from the dazzling reflection.
entries.zh: 耀眼的反光让他不得不移开目光。

entries.en: The historical exhibit included a bottle labeled as an abortifacient.
entries.zh: 这个历史展览中有一个标注为堕胎药的药瓶。

entries.en: Her extraverted personality helped newcomers feel welcome.
entries.zh: 她外向的性格让新来的人感到受欢迎。

entries.en: The rider checked the snaffle before leading the horse outside.
entries.zh: 骑手把马牵到外面之前检查了马嚼子。

entries.en: He offered to work off the debt by repairing the fence.
entries.zh: 他提出通过修理篱笆来抵偿债务。

entries.en: The abandoned strip became a no man's land between the two farms.
entries.zh: 那片废弃地带成了两座农场之间的无人区。

entries.en: The parcel was too large for the narrow letterbox.
entries.zh: 包裹太大，放不进狭窄的信箱。

entries.en: We can play back the recording after the interview.
entries.zh: 采访结束后，我们可以回放录音。

entries.en: Her grandfather often spoke of winters in the old country.
entries.zh: 她祖父常谈起移民前祖国的冬天。

entries.en: Organizing large parties is not really my cup of tea.
entries.zh: 组织大型聚会并不是我喜欢的事。

entries.en: The laboratory compared several samples of siliceous rock.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了几份含硅岩石样本。

entries.en: The review criticized a scene in which characters behaved lewdly.
entries.zh: 评论批评了一个人物举止淫荡的场景。

entries.en: The boy tried to shinny up the smooth pole.
entries.zh: 男孩试着爬上那根光滑的杆子。

entries.en: We need to figure out which cable has come loose.
entries.zh: 我们需要弄清楚哪根电缆松了。

entries.en: She clung to the slippery railing for dear life.
entries.zh: 她拼命抓住湿滑的栏杆。

entries.en: A young man offered to carry the heavy bag.
entries.zh: 一位青年主动提出帮忙提那个重袋子。

entries.en: This is by all odds the finest sketch in the collection.
entries.zh: 毫无疑问，这是藏品中最出色的素描。

entries.en: Week after week, the volunteers returned to clean the riverbank.
entries.zh: 志愿者们连续好几个星期回来清理河岸。

entries.en: The organizers may call off the parade because of flooding.
entries.zh: 组织者可能会因洪水而取消游行。

entries.en: The guide will briefly touch on the building's industrial past.
entries.zh: 导游会简要提及这幢楼的工业历史。

entries.en: The choir gave a zestful performance despite the rain.
entries.zh: 尽管下着雨，合唱团仍献上了充满热情的演出。

entries.en: Intense heat can ablate the outer layer of the shield.
entries.zh: 高温可以烧蚀防护罩的外层。

entries.en: The critic objected to the film's glamorization of reckless driving.
entries.zh: 评论家反对电影对鲁莽驾驶的美化。

entries.en: The clerk checked the signed order of payment.
entries.zh: 职员核查了签字的付款凭单。

entries.en: A lavish holiday could run through their remaining savings.
entries.zh: 一次奢华的假期可能会花光他们剩下的积蓄。

entries.en: Please move back so the passengers can leave the train.
entries.zh: 请往后退，让乘客下车。

entries.en: The driver completed a three-point turn in the narrow road.
entries.zh: 司机在狭窄的道路上完成了一次三点掉头。

entries.en: The loose screws may fall out during transport.
entries.zh: 松动的螺丝可能在运输过程中脱落。

entries.en: These stone steps date from the original construction.
entries.zh: 这些石阶始建于最初的建造时期。

entries.en: He could recite the whole poem by memory.
entries.zh: 他能凭记忆背诵整首诗。

entries.en: The association hopes to professionalize the training of local guides.
entries.zh: 协会希望使当地导游的培训专业化。

entries.en: The oldness of the fabric showed in its faded colors.
entries.zh: 织物褪去的颜色显出了它的陈旧。

entries.en: The council debated the reimposition of the abandoned parking fee.
entries.zh: 委员会讨论了重新征收已取消停车费的问题。

entries.en: The family had a hard time after the shop closed.
entries.zh: 商店关闭后，这个家庭经历了一段艰难时期。

entries.en: The tank will run over if you leave the tap open.
entries.zh: 如果一直开着水龙头，水箱里的水就会溢出来。

entries.en: Several residents decided to speak out against the proposed closure.
entries.zh: 几位居民决定大胆发声，反对拟议中的关闭计划。

entries.en: The department of economics occupies the building near the main gate.
entries.zh: 经济系位于大门附近的那幢楼里。

entries.en: The narrow boat can move through the shallow channel.
entries.zh: 那条窄船可以穿过浅水航道。

entries.en: In point of fact, the door had never been locked.
entries.zh: 实际上，那扇门从未锁过。

entries.en: The poet imagined a measureless ocean beneath the stars.
entries.zh: 诗人想象着星空下一片无边无际的海洋。

entries.en: She stared dispiritedly at the unfinished stack of forms.
entries.zh: 她气馁地盯着那叠还没填完的表格。

entries.en: Her interest in herpetology began with observing pond animals.
entries.zh: 她对爬行动物学的兴趣始于观察池塘动物。

entries.en: The historical map marks a house of correction near the canal.
entries.zh: 这张历史地图在运河附近标出了一座改造所。

entries.en: Could you move over to make room for another person?
entries.zh: 你能挪一下，给另一个人腾个位置吗？

entries.en: We should leave off painting before the light fades.
entries.zh: 我们应该在光线变暗前停止刷漆。

entries.en: A wider lens increases the camera's angle of view.
entries.zh: 更广角的镜头会增大相机的视角。

entries.en: The stalled delivery could make the entire project grind to a halt.
entries.zh: 交货停滞可能使整个项目逐渐陷入停顿。

entries.en: Please write your first name above your surname.
entries.zh: 请在姓氏上方写下你的名。

entries.en: After rebuilding the engine, fixing the latch seemed like child's play.
entries.zh: 重装发动机之后，修门闩似乎成了轻而易举的事。

entries.en: The score includes a violin obbligato that must not be omitted.
entries.zh: 乐谱中有一段不可省略的小提琴助奏。

entries.en: A fluky bounce sent the ball straight into the goal.
entries.zh: 球一次碰巧的弹跳让它直接进了球门。

entries.en: The fictional millionairess purchases an abandoned theater for restoration.
entries.zh: 这位虚构的女百万富翁买下一座废弃剧院，准备修复。

entries.en: The partners plan to buy out the retiring founder.
entries.zh: 合伙人计划买下退休创办人持有的全部股权。

entries.en: The dog remained on guard beside the open gate.
entries.zh: 那只狗在敞开的大门旁保持警惕。

entries.en: A difference of opinion delayed the committee's final decision.
entries.zh: 一项意见分歧推迟了委员会的最终决定。

entries.en: Take a moment to look around before choosing a seat.
entries.zh: 选座位之前，先花点时间环顾四周。

entries.en: The worksheet asks students to identify the degree of a polynomial.
entries.zh: 练习纸要求学生确定一个多项式的次数。

entries.en: He uses his free time to restore old radios.
entries.zh: 他用空闲时间修复旧收音机。

entries.en: The researcher marked prosodic features in the recorded conversation.
entries.zh: 研究人员标注了录制谈话中的韵律特征。

entries.en: The lesson explores polysemy through several everyday words.
entries.zh: 这节课通过几个日常词语探讨一词多义现象。

entries.en: The pathologist marked the dysplastic cells in the image.
entries.zh: 病理学家在图像中标出了发育异常的细胞。

entries.en: We eventually managed to settle on a suitable date.
entries.zh: 我们最终设法选定了一个合适的日期。

entries.en: The manager refused to turn a blind eye to missing receipts.
entries.zh: 经理拒绝对收据遗失的问题视而不见。

entries.en: On average, the workshop receives ten visitors each morning.
entries.zh: 平均而言，这个工坊每天上午接待十位游客。

entries.en: The trail climbs into the high country below the timberline.
entries.zh: 步道向上延伸到林木线以下的高地。

entries.en: Several delegates threatened to walk out during the debate.
entries.zh: 几位代表威胁要在辩论中退席抗议。

entries.en: The repair bill could reach into thousands of dollars.
entries.zh: 维修账单可能达到数千美元。

entries.en: She invited her kinsfolk to share the anniversary meal.
entries.zh: 她邀请亲属一起吃周年纪念餐。

entries.en: The chart marks each decile with a vertical line.
entries.zh: 图表用一条竖线标出了每个十分位数。

entries.en: Uneven paving made the cart joggle from side to side.
entries.zh: 不平的路面让小推车左右晃动。

entries.en: The old stove heated water through a metal water back.
entries.zh: 那台旧炉子通过金属背水箱加热水。

entries.en: These caterpillars feed on the leaves of young cabbages.
entries.zh: 这些毛毛虫以嫩卷心菜的叶子为食。

entries.en: I hope to pay back your kindness by helping with the move.
entries.zh: 我希望通过帮忙搬家来报答你的好意。

entries.en: A good person helped us carry the broken bicycle home.
entries.zh: 一位好人帮我们把坏自行车抬回了家。

entries.en: Their generous donation was a vote of confidence in the project.
entries.zh: 他们慷慨的捐赠表达了对这个项目的信任与支持。

entries.en: The square fills with stalls on market day.
entries.zh: 集市日那天，广场上摆满了摊位。

entries.en: He laid the short log across the sawbuck.
entries.zh: 他把短木头横放在锯木架上。

entries.en: The undersurface of the leaf was covered in fine hairs.
entries.zh: 叶子的背面覆盖着细毛。

entries.en: A slight indisposition kept her away from the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 轻微的身体不适让她没能参加彩排。

entries.en: The owner invited the committee into the back room.
entries.zh: 店主请委员会成员进了里屋。

entries.en: Please check the address once more before posting it.
entries.zh: 寄出前，请再检查一次地址。

entries.en: The local government maintains the paths beside the river.
entries.zh: 地方政府维护着河边的小径。

entries.en: We will send out the invitations after confirming the venue.
entries.zh: 确定场地后，我们会发出邀请。

entries.en: She rinsed the washrag and hung it beside the basin.
entries.zh: 她漂洗了面巾，把它挂在盆边。

entries.en: The essay examines the corruptive influence of unchecked power.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了不受约束的权力使人腐化的影响。

entries.en: The small leak remained unperceived behind the cupboard.
entries.zh: 柜子后面的那处小漏水一直未被察觉。

entries.en: The guidebook devotes a chapter to the town's night life.
entries.zh: 旅行指南专门用一章介绍这个镇的夜生活。

entries.en: Her social work includes helping older residents find support.
entries.zh: 她的社会福利工作包括帮助老年居民寻找支持。

entries.en: The new owners tried to force out the remaining tenants.
entries.zh: 新业主试图迫使剩下的租客搬走。

entries.en: We should air out the spare room before guests arrive.
entries.zh: 客人到来之前，我们应该给客房通通风。

entries.en: The office will change over to electronic records next month.
entries.zh: 办公室下个月将改用电子记录。

entries.en: His friends tried to egg him on to enter the contest.
entries.zh: 朋友们试图怂恿他参加比赛。

entries.en: The psychologist described his loud confidence as possible overcompensation.
entries.zh: 心理学家认为，他张扬的自信可能是一种过度补偿。

entries.en: Please recopy the damaged section onto a clean sheet.
entries.zh: 请把损坏的那一部分重新抄到干净纸上。

entries.en: Pressing this key starts a new line in the document.
entries.zh: 按这个键会在文档中开始新的一行。

entries.en: The whole family will root for her team.
entries.zh: 全家人都会为她的球队加油。

entries.en: Keep the measuring tape ready to hand during fitting.
entries.zh: 试衣时，把卷尺放在伸手可取的地方。

entries.en: The students will act out the scene in small groups.
entries.zh: 学生们将分成小组表演这个场景。

entries.en: The printer measured type sizes using the point system.
entries.zh: 印刷工用点制测量字号。

entries.en: The judgment emphasized the importance of due process of law.
entries.zh: 判决强调了正当法律程序的重要性。

entries.en: The retired neighbors often keep company with each other.
entries.zh: 这两位退休邻居经常相互作伴。

entries.en: The laboratory labeled the triploid plant samples for analysis.
entries.zh: 实验室给三倍体植物样本贴上标签，以便分析。

entries.en: The iciness of her greeting surprised a longtime friend.
entries.zh: 她问候时的冷淡让一位多年老友吃了一惊。

entries.en: Leaving the unlocked bicycle outside was an act of imprudence.
entries.zh: 把没锁的自行车放在外面是轻率之举。

entries.en: The marker showed the projectile's line of fire across the diagram.
entries.zh: 标记在图中显示了弹丸的发射线。

entries.en: The short review could not do justice to her detailed research.
entries.zh: 这篇简短的评论未能充分肯定她细致的研究。

entries.en: The village bakery is its beating heart, so to speak.
entries.zh: 打个比方说，村里的面包店就是它跳动的心脏。

entries.en: The disputed document was eventually examined in a court of law.
entries.zh: 那份有争议的文件最终在法庭上接受了审查。

entries.en: The teacher connected force and acceleration using the second law of motion.
entries.zh: 老师运用运动第二定律联系了力与加速度。

entries.en: The museum displayed a model of a panopticon with a central watchtower.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一座带中央瞭望塔的圆形监狱模型。

entries.en: The new recording is comparable to the orchestra's finest performances.
entries.zh: 这张新录音可以与乐团最出色的演出媲美。

entries.en: The lantern procession was the high point of the festival.
entries.zh: 灯笼巡游是庆典中最精彩的部分。

entries.en: A young woman offered us directions to the harbor.
entries.zh: 一位年轻女子告诉了我们去港口的路线。

entries.en: We need to clear out the cellar before the repairs.
entries.zh: 维修前，我们需要清空地窖。

entries.en: The housekeeper arranged the tea trays in the still room.
entries.zh: 女管家在茶点整备室里摆好了茶盘。

entries.en: The notice warned of possible distraint for unpaid rent.
entries.zh: 通知警告说，未付租金可能导致财物被扣押。

entries.en: The badly damaged chairs were considered unsalable.
entries.zh: 那些严重损坏的椅子被认为卖不掉了。

entries.en: The biology lesson described a parthenogenetic form of reproduction.
entries.zh: 生物课介绍了一种孤雌生殖形式。

entries.en: The lawyer explained the surviving spouse's right of election.
entries.zh: 律师解释了尚存配偶的遗产选择权。

entries.en: The family rented a country house overlooking the valley.
entries.zh: 这家人租了一幢俯瞰山谷的乡间别墅。

entries.en: You may come across old photographs in the attic.
entries.zh: 你可能会在阁楼里无意中发现旧照片。

entries.en: He began to see red when the same mistake happened again.
entries.zh: 同样的错误再次发生时，他开始火冒三丈。

entries.meaningZh: 在乡间别墅举行的连续数日的宴会
entries.en: They organized a house party at a country house for the entire holiday weekend.
entries.zh: 他们在一幢乡间别墅组织了一场持续整个假期周末的聚会。

entries.en: We chose a day game so the children could attend.
entries.zh: 我们选择了一场日间比赛，好让孩子们也能参加。
